review.scope: Independent plan ownership lifecycle provenance and proof-route review

source_edits.scope: The independent reviewing agent made no source or test edits

report_write.receipt: User explicitly requested the Stage 1 diagnostic entrypoint on 2026-08-23

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: stage1.py remains the single loss optimizer-step ratio and temporary Direction Bank owner; the script only assembles identity and renders JSON.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: Immutable diagnostic config and points expose only checkpoint metrics; no artifact or active-axis override enters the interface.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: The new script depends inward on the calibration-training public owner, while both formal and diagnostic paths share the same private optimizer-step Pinch Point.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: The plan covers successful and exceptional restoration of policy parameters gradients requires_grad and mode, and poisons publication from diagnostics.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The bounded change adds typed diagnostics, one shared optimizer-step extraction, one thin CLI, and focused owner and entrypoint tests.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: The entrypoint produces optimization telemetry only and makes no Stage 1 quality, simulator, deployment, or policy claim.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: RED and GREEN tests cover shared-step sequencing, same-snapshot metrics, provenance, invalid config, exception restoration, high-ratio reporting, formal gate preservation, and no publication.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: The exact dataset source split and Axis Spec identity reach the owner and JSON; metrics retain axis and checkpoint identity.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Only the temporary Direction Bank may update; the same optimizer step checks frozen policy and non-selected axes for both paths.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Diagnostics print JSON and cannot call the atomic Stage artifact publisher; the formal gate and artifact schema remain unchanged.

residual_risks: READY permits bounded offline implementation only; the resulting entrypoint must still be synchronized and run on the server before it can distinguish under-optimization from representation failure.
